entities.summary: James Charles Phillips is an American physicist and a member of the National Academy of Sciences (1978). He invented the exact theory of the ionicity of chemical bonding in semiconductors, as well as new theories of compacted networks. He is known for having developed the rigidity theory to study glass alloys and later protein evolution.
